summary: The product team met to review Q2 OKR progress, currently at 78% completion with three weeks remaining. Key discussions covered a payment gateway refactor blocked on Stripe API documentation, a simplified onboarding flow design, and three critical checkout bugs requiring immediate prioritization. The team aligned on postponing dark mode to Q4 and agreed to introduce weekly bug triage sessions starting next Monday.

action_items.description: Reach out to Stripe support for payment gateway API documentation
Update Figma prototype for onboarding Step 3 with optional fields removed
Assign cart persistence bug to Lisa Huang for fix
Deliver fix for cart persistence on refresh bug
Submit Q3 roadmap team updates to Sarah
Send calendar invites for weekly bug triage meetings

decisions: Remove optional fields from onboarding Step 3 to simplify the user flow
Postpone dark mode feature to Q4 to focus engineering capacity on checkout stability
Introduce weekly bug triage meetings starting next Monday at 10am
